_comment: Counts manifest for agents/julia/train.jl -- point DatasetSpec.counts_file here.
Two replicate lineages (F and R), two selection rounds each, in order.
This is the structure the campaign's data actually has, and the one the
notebooks in PD_energy_model/training/training_2rounds build their tree from:
columns [F2, F3, R2, R3] map to nodes [root F, child F, root R, child R].
The *_nogap.csv files are used because the others carry '*' and '_' from stop
codons and frameshifts. The model is still trained on the 21-wide gapped
alphabet so its exported weights stay interchangeable with the promoted
colabdesign/energy_model/model_3layer.py, which pads a zero gap column at
inference time. The gap column simply never gets occupied -- exactly as in
